evidence.reason: The inventory claims an exact allowlisted topology but `_show` reads only LoadState, ActiveState, UnitFileState, and FragmentPath. systemd applies drop-ins from all user unit-load directories, so a drop-in outside the local managed directory can override the timer's effective trigger target while FragmentPath remains unchanged. The adapter therefore can accept an active timer that will not trigger the expected service, making the subsequent release/completion check unreliable. This is an existing exact-topology validation defect, not merely a request to enlarge protection scope.
